description: A CommitFile (blame descend target) only offers gitdiff+details — no way to see the file as of that commit. Add a CommitSourceMode reading 'git show sha:path' (sibling of Git.show), add to CommitFile POLICY in mode_resolver.rb. Auto-mode decision pending (diff-first vs source-first; lean diff-first since blame arrival asks 'what changed'). Also fixes viewing files a commit deleted (expand_commit skips non-existent paths, git.rb:194).
title: Source-at-commit facet: view a CommitFile's contents, not just its diff

description: The guiding-star plan layer IS the beads DB (decided 2026-07-03, replaces an invented Plan/PlanItem model). A provider maps issues->nodes and deps->typed edges (PARENT/BLOCKS/REFERENCES), issue-linked files unify with fs.path identities so a walk descends bead -> file -> blame -> commit. Start by shelling out to bd --json (the git-provider pattern); direct dolt SQL (server already on :3307, MySQL protocol) is the likely follow-up for reasonable client-style usage — hcolumns as an active client of the DB, not command-per-guess. Survey of ~/src/beads current state in progress before design.
design:
Survey of ~/src/beads (v1.1.0-rc.2, 2026-07) — integration-shaping facts:

STORAGE: Dolt is the ONLY backend (SQLite/JSONL-sync/daemon removed v0.49.6-v0.51.0). .beads/issues.jsonl is a passive viewer export, NOT truth. Our repo initialized in SERVER mode (shared dolt sql-server :3307, database 'hc', data dir .beads/dolt) because a server was already running.

NO DAEMON/RPC/HTTP API — bd is purely CLI. BUT server mode IS a real MySQL-wire endpoint, queryable directly + concurrently. So the 'active client' vision = hold a SQL connection to :3307; no bd fork per column.

PROVIDER PATH:
- Phase 1 (shell-out): batch-first — bd list --json / bd query / bd sql --json / bd export; avoid N x bd show (deps not hydrated by default; --include-dependents is the slow path). Set BD_JSON_ENVELOPE=1 and parse both envelope shapes ({schema_version,data} becomes default in v2.0).
- Phase 2 (client): MySQL-wire connection to the dolt server. Candidate: pure-Ruby 'ruby-mysql' gem keeps hcolumns' no-native-deps posture. Watch the schema-newer fail-fast guard (a DB written by newer bd should be read with caution — check schema version).

EDGES: dependencies table = (issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id). Types incl. blocks, parent-child, conditional-blocks, waits-for (ready-work-affecting) + related, discovered-from, duplicates, supersedes, tracks, caused-by... (Decision 004: graph links moved INTO this table; old scalar fields stale). Hierarchical dotted IDs (hc-x.1) mirror parent-child edges. This maps 1:1 onto hcolumns typed/directed edges.

FILE LINKS: no first-class file attach. Sanctioned extension point = the issue 'metadata' JSON field (docs/METADATA.md explicitly suggests file lists) — the agent bridge should write file associations there; provider reads metadata (agent-kind evidence) + heuristic path-parse of description (inference-kind).

Schema of record: internal/types/types.go; SQL: internal/storage/schema/migrations/0001,0002; JSON contract: docs/JSON_SCHEMA.md.
title: Beads provider: explore a project's beads database as columns
